stringUnit.value: Preview only. Live writes, agreements, money, messages and complaints are disabled.
仅预览。实际提交、协议、资金、消息和投诉均未启用。

This is a local draft. Nothing has been sent or accepted.
这是本地草稿，尚未发送或接受任何内容。
Templates are create-only. Retail price must be positive, cost nonnegative, both up to 99,999,999.99 with two decimals. Quota must be a positive integer.
模板仅支持新增。零售价须为正数，成本非负，金额不超过 99,999,999.99 且最多两位小数，额度须为正整数。
Source amounts are CNY; no currency conversion is applied.
源金额币种为人民币，不进行汇率换算。
Enter a name, valid price and positive quota to continue.
请填写名称、有效价格和正整数额度。
Only the selected topic and reason are submitted. Support determines fault and compensation.
只提交所选主题和原因，责任与赔付由客服处理。
A reason is required to cancel accepted cooperation.
取消已接受的合作必须填写原因。
Frozen terms and historical invitations are read-only. This screen does not sign an agreement or confirm a refund.
锁定条款与历史邀约仅供查看，本页面不会签署协议或确认退款。
The chapter determines the terms mode. Pausing preserves history; reconfirming renews the current offer.
条款档由章节决定。暂停保留历史，重新确认只续当前供给。
Each recipient is reviewed separately. Ordinary invitations support traffic or fixed fees only.
每位受邀方单独核对。普通邀约仅支持引流或固定合作费。
